rule: When the vendor's annual rows mix the currencies of the issuer's 20-F in more than one year or in the latest year, the annual statements are built from the 20-F XBRL facts, in the 20-F reporting currency, for every consecutive year the filings cover; vendor annual, trailing, interim and quarterly rows are not used.

PETR3.SA.reason: Vendor rows mix the reais accounts filed in Brazil with the US-dollar 20-F under USD labels (FY2023 income in dollars, equity and cash flow in reais; FY2024-FY2025 reais labelled USD).

YPF.US.reason: YPF presents its 20-F in US dollars (its functional currency) from FY2020 comparatives; the vendor rows are pesos with dollar cash flows inside (FY2021-FY2024).

JBS.US.reason: JBS N.V. reports in US dollars; the vendor's FY2025 row is the reais accounts of JBS S.A. under a USD label (sales 471.1bn against US$86.2bn in the 20-F).
